subject: Flexible Event Ops Retainer — Q3–Q4 2027 pop-up + conference support
messages:
From: Aaron Kim <aaron@pixelcraft.studio>

Cc: Pixelcraft Studio Contracts <contracts@pixelcraft.studio>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Proposal: Flexible Event Ops Retainer for Redwood (Q3–Q4 2027)

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the intro over Slack. Per our call, attached is our flexible retainer proposal that covers pop-up activations, conference booth build + teardown support, and a small on-demand design pool for collateral updates. Highlights:

- 100 guaranteed hours/month across production, logistics, and design
- Blocked rate for on-site crew (4 people) at $1,800/day per person when booked through retainer
- 48-hour turn for urgent design requests (within the retained hours)
- Rollover up to 20% of unused hours month-to-month during active 6-month term

I've also attached our 2027 event ops ratecard for reference. Happy to walk through specific line items — do you want a short walkthrough tomorrow?

Best,

Aaron
Aaron Kim
Head of Partnerships
Pixelcraft Studio

Attachments: Pixelcraft_Q3-Q4-flex-retainer_2027_v1.pdf, ratecard_event_ops_2027.xlsx

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-11T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Flexible Event Ops Retainer for Redwood (Q3–Q4 2027)

Thanks Aaron — this looks promising. Two quick asks before we move to contracting:

1) Can you split the ratecard between on-site crew (labor) and third-party rentals (AV/furniture) — we prefer pass-through billing for rentals.
2) We'd like a sample SOW appendix that shows scope for a standard conference booth (setup, 3 days onsite, tech run, teardown).

Cc'ing Lauren (procurement) and Marissa (Marketing ops) to loop them in on terms and budget.

Also, FYI we prefer a 6-month term with automatic review at month 4 for scaling.

Thanks,

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Manager, Events

Aaron — looping legal (not on thread) but ran an initial procurement pass. High-level redlines attached as a Word doc (redlines_jordan_20270112.docx). Key asks:

- Limit rollovers to a 12-month cumulative cap (not month-to-month above 20%)

- Clarify cancellation fees for on-site crew less than 72 hours notice
- Update insurance minimums to match Redwood's enterprise policy (details in doc)

If you can accept those, we can move to DocuSign. Also request: please include a standard invoice template and remittance instructions.
